test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate spelling that can correctly substitute the misspelt underlined segment in the given sentence.**

His part in the affair was quite open and **__abboard__**.
solution:
The correct answer is **"above board."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Above board"** means honest and open, without any hidden motives or deception. (ईमानदार और खुला, बिना किसी छुपे मकसद या धोखे के)

 
 
• **Example**: *We felt the judging was all **above board**__ and fair.*
 
 
 
• The misspelt word **"abboard"** is not a correct English word.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 

**Correct sentence**: *His part in the affair was quite open and __**above board**__.*

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, "abroad,"** means in or to another country or countries. (विदेश में; विदेश को)
 
• **Option 2, "board,"** means to get on a plane, ship, bus, etc. (विमान, जहाज़, बस आदि में सवार होना)
 
• **Option 4, "broad," **refers wide. (चौड़ा)

15d:Td2d,

The correct answer is **"fireside."**
